## Mova Workspace Instructions

- Keep the project centered on Electron + React + TypeScript + Vite + local SQLite for the desktop app.
- Preserve the premium, non-generic financial product identity and avoid standard admin-dashboard patterns.
- Share brand tokens and business logic through `packages/core` whenever possible.
- Maintain local-first behavior for finance, inventory, sales, expenses, investments, and reports.
- Keep the landing page aligned with the desktop app visual language.
- Prefer small, focused edits and validate desktop changes with targeted checks.
